name: coordinate-root-npm-test-validation-capacity
title: Coordinate root bare npm test with workspace validation capacity without parent-child deadlock
description: Mechanism Placement Proof: A1 existing official validation capacity was delivered by B-6693, but root bare npm test remains intentionally outside it. A2 the official chain is done_required_validate -> withOfficialValidationExecution -> npm test -> full-suite-runner, while a direct npm test enters full-suite-runner without workspace capacity. A3 repeated B-d0b8 DONE-required failures while unrelated direct tests were live, followed by isolated member PASS, prove a runtime coordination gap rather than configuration, build-artifact, or operator error. A4 no active Story covers the root bare entry; B-6f23 concerns nested agent-liveness parallelism and B-6693 is DONE. A5 a naive second acquire deadlocks the official parent and child, so delegation must be workspace-, holder-, and process-bound and must preserve existing budgets, inventory, evidence persistence, and stdout/stderr contracts. A6 the minimum authoritative hook is the root full-suite-runner entry plus the existing validation-capacity ownership implementation; official callers expose a narrowly bounded verifiable delegation and bare callers acquire normally.
source: User requested one total goal with three independent Stories; this is Story C.
